note: Ground truth for the public release litellm 1.83.3 (PyPI sdist, fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs; manifest.json pins the sha256), audited with `--scope litellm/proxy`. Never copy this file into the audited directory. `locations` are files relative to the sdist root (the run's app/) with 1-based inclusive line ranges, verified with `node benchmark/real/fetch.mjs pypi/litellm 1.83.3 --check`. Same format and matching rules as benchmark/answer-key.json. The 1.83.7 key is the false-positive control.

seeded.class: GHSA-r75f-5x8p-qvmc (CVE-2026-42208): the caller's API key value is interpolated into the SQL text of the key lookup, reachable without authentication
seeded.why: PrismaClient.get_data(table_name='combined_view') builds the key lookup as an f-string, `WHERE v.token = '{token}'` (line 3018), and runs it with no parameters (lines 3021-3023). _hash_token_if_needed() (line 4649) hashes only values starting with 'sk-', so any other Authorization value reaches the query as typed. On a failed request _ProxyDBLogger in proxy/hooks/proxy_track_cost_callback.py (line 313) calls get_key_object() in proxy/auth/auth_checks.py with the caller's key, so the query runs without authentication unless disable_error_logs is set. A verifier that assumes the token is always hashed is wrong. Fixed in 1.83.7 by passing the hashed token as $1.

seeded.class: GHSA-v4p8-mg3p-g94g (CVE-2026-42271): the MCP server test endpoints accept a stdio server configuration from any API key holder and start its command on the host
seeded.why: POST /mcp-rest/test/connection (line 1021) and /mcp-rest/test/tools/list (line 1044) take a full NewMCPServerRequest, including command, args and env, and connect with it through _execute_with_mcp_client(); for the stdio transport client.py lines 240-248 build StdioServerParameters and start the process. The endpoints only require a valid key, with no PROXY_ADMIN check, unlike the endpoint that saves a server. A verifier that treats 'requires an API key' as authorization is wrong. Fixed in 1.83.7 with a PROXY_ADMIN role check on both.
